corrections: Replaced generic fighter geometry with Block 15 F-16B body stations, hollow chin intake, 40-degree swept wing, enlarged anhedral stabilators, fin, ventral fins, individual nozzle petals and measured wheel locations.
Reconstructed tandem canopy and separate reclined seats from B photographs; removed opaque skin beneath the cockpit and overlapping nose loft.
Distinct original Block 15 front and rear analog panel outlines and instrument positions; rear twin display housings and handgrip, front HUD glass/control housing and lower pedestal.

Live TAS, geometric altitude with signed five-digit counter and hundreds needle, attitude/standby attitude, true heading, climb and angle-of-attack pointer on both panels. Missing data hides moving readings against black faces.

Named expressions mix flap and roll into flaperons, pitch and roll into stabilators, and move tiny-deflection force sticks, throttle, pedals and gear. Heading-card direction checked at four cardinal headings.
Geometric access seams, selected fastener rows, intake/rescue markings, gear braces and hubs; no external weapons or stores.
Dedicated cabin inspection camera avoids the seat back; standard operator camera uses the authored pilot eye.
independentDimensions: Overall 49ft6in (15.0876m) length and 31ft (9.4488m) span without missiles, 16ft8.5in (5.0927m) height.
13ft2in (4.0132m) wheelbase, 93in (2.3622m) main track, 40-degree leading-edge sweep and 10-degree stabilator anhedral independently checked.

Front/rear panel drawings calibrated uniformly to approximately80/83mm instrument faces. Seat spacing, cockpit depth and canopy cross-section are photographic reconstructions, not certified dimensions.
reviewNotes.visual: Inspected current-hash side/top/front and separate front/rear-panel overlays, four turntable views, three-quarter, operator, cabin, cabin-wide, zero/cruise/limits/below-sea-level/missing instrument states, rear cockpit, side-stick, close exterior and canopy side. A-model canopy and stores in general-arrangement drawing explicitly excluded; B canopy compared separately to the cited photograph.
limitations: Polygonal interpretation of an original analog Block 15 F-16B; reference B photograph depicts a later MLU airframe and only informs external canopy/body shape.
Panel dimensions, seating, side-console switch identities, duct depth, landing-gear folding and detailed skin/fastener positions remain approximations; not every rivet is reproduced.

Airspeed is simulation TAS, altitude geometric and heading true; not calibrated pitot-static IAS/Mach/pressure altitude or magnetic navigation. Dial calibration and angle-of-attack scale are illustrative.

Unsupported engine fuel/temperature/oil/RPM and navigation/radar displays are blank or INOP. HUD glass has no collimated display. Flight controls do not implement the real FLCS or automatic leading-edge flap logic.
Flight smoke establishes controllability in the shared simplified dynamics, not certification of F-16 performance. No external stores or weapons systems.
The publicly hosted flight manual carries reproduction restrictions: its diagrams remain local study evidence and are not redistributed in the model or preview.
